title: Aoyagi Toya — Delicious Cultural Exposure〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Flea Market
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pretty cool sneaker shop over there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They've got a lot of brands that you don't see back in Japan. Find anything interesting on your end?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm having some trouble choosing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Wait, you're looking at tableware?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is apparently what you normally find in your standard American diner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, I was wondering why these looked so familiar.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like these dishes with the lines around the edges. Oh, and these mugs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They all have a uniquely American feel to them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And they're surprisingly cheap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They were apparently rotated out for newer stock, which is why they're being offered at a special discount right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You don't say. Still, I'm surprised.
I didn't realize you were interested in this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not exactly...
<Look at those cups! They seem so fancy!>
<Luka, wait. You're going to stick out like a sore thumb.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha. I'm sorry.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We apologize for interrupting your shopping.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not at all. Anyway, what brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We were curious about the flea market. So, we decided to come take a look.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<We were trying to be discreet...
Is it okay for us to stay?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you can stay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Great! Don't mind us, then!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We've actually been taking peeks here and there for a little while now. I can't believe how many shops they have here.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Right? It's so exciting!
And just look at these stylish dishes!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. Colorful dishes like these might even make the food at the cafe taste more delicious.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there anything in particular that you like?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hmm... Oh, I really like these mugs!
They're so cute and colorful!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Blue, red and yellow...
Seeing them all lined up like this is so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, vivid colors such as these can have an uplifting effect.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I think my favorite are these divided lunch plates, because of their simple design.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <These subdued colors should help the food on them stand out. And these partitions allow you to serve several things all at once without the flavors running together. As such, they seem very practical.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they do seem rather versatile.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I also really like those over there...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you for letting us look at tableware with the both of you. We had a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We hardly ever get these kinds of opportunities. I enjoyed getting to see things up close!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also glad that you two had a chance to join us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? They're calling for us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Then, we'll excuse ourselves here.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This was a lot of fun! See you later!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, see you.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's go over that way next, you guys.
Slade and Cedric said there's a shop that they really recommend!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, we'll head over once we've finished making our purchases over here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, we'll meet you guys there.
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're going to buy something here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm thinking about buying some things for everyone in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka and MEIKO both showed great interest, after all. And I had been thinking I'd like to thank them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even while we're here in the US, they've been taking the time to come talk to us and watch us practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, that's why you were looking at dishes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something they can use at the cafe would be good, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. But are you sure about buying everything now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think it's a good idea to take a bunch of fragile things to a music event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. I'll have to take everything over to SEKAI the next chance I get.
